title: Triangular polynomial substitution with scalar leading coefficient
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $n\ge1$, and let $g\in R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ be nonconstant, meaning $g$ is not in the image of the constant-polynomial map $R\to R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. There exist positive integers $e_1,\ldots,e_{n-1}$, an integer $d>0$, a nonzero coefficient $a\in R$ of $g$, and polynomials $b_j\in R[x_1,\ldots,x_{n-1}]$ for $0\le j<d$, such that $$g(x_1+x_n^{e_1},\ldots,x_{n-1}+x_n^{e_{n-1}},x_n)=a x_n^d+\sum_{j=0}^{d-1} b_j x_n^j.$$ For $n=1$ the exponent list is empty and the displayed substitution is the identity.
